  FACILITY:      100 MWth / 45 MWe NEXT-GENERATION HIGH-EFFICIENCY NUCLEAR / CONCENTRATED SOLAR PLANT
  SUBSYSTEM:     MAIN COMPRESSOR (MC) & RECOMPRESSOR (RC) CYBER-PHYSICAL SYNCHRONOUS GOVERNOR
  DISCIPLINE:    TURBOMACHINERY AERODYNAMICS / ROTORDYNAMICS / THERMOHYDRAULICS / ADVANCED IEC 61131-3
  IEC STANDARD:  IEC 61131-3 STRUCTURED TEXT 3RD EDITION (DETERMINISTIC EMBEDDED EXECUTION, 10 ms SCAN)
  AUTHOR:        LUMINA AI CLOUD SWARM - PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CPS CHAIR (UPGRADED V7 MAX)
  TARGET CYCLE:  RECOMPRESSION CLOSED BRAYTON CYCLE (RCBC) WITH DUAL-RECUPERATED ARCHITECTURE (LTR/HTR)
  DESIGN LIMITS: 250.0 bar (25.0 MPa) DISCHARGE | 600.0 DEG C TURBINE INLET | 31.1 DEG C / 73.9 bar SUCTION
  ====================================================================================================

  1.0 THERMODYNAMIC PHENOMENOLOGY & CRITICAL POINT ANOMALIES
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The supercritical carbon dioxide (sCO2) Brayton cycle offers thermodynamic thermal efficiencies
  exceeding 50% by exploiting the sharp non-linear thermophysical property divergence occurring adjacent
  to the vapor-liquid critical point (Tc = 304.128 K / 30.978 deg C, Pc = 7.3773 MPa / 73.773 bar,
  rhoc = 467.6 kg/m3). Operating the Main Compressor (MC) suction near 31.1 deg C and 7.39 MPa places
  the fluid precisely within the 'Widom line' region (the locus of maximum thermodynamic response
  functions such as isobaric heat capacity Cp, isothermal compressibility kappa_T, and volume expansivity
  beta_p). In this regime:
    a) Density (rho) undergoes severe gradients: a temperature drift of barely 0.5 K can cause local
       density to swing from 250 kg/m3 to over 620 kg/m3.
    b) Local speed of sound (a = sqrt((dP/drho)_s)) plummets to an acoustic minimum (~210 - 240 m/s),
       producing high blade-tip acoustic Mach numbers (Mau > 0.95) despite modest peripheral velocities.
    c) Isobaric heat capacity (Cp) diverges to extreme peaks exceeding 15.0 kJ/(kg*K), inducing an
       extreme 'pinch-point' bottleneck inside the Low-Temperature Recuperator (LTR).
    d) Isothermal compressibility approaches singular behavior, rendering traditional volumetric flow
       anti-surge lines completely invalid. Conventional anti-surge controllers based solely on head vs.
       volumetric flow experience catastrophic false trips or fail to prevent aerodynamic blade stall.

  2.0 DENSITY SURGE MARGIN TRACKING ARCHITECTURE
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Centrifugal compression of near-critical sCO2 cannot rely on classical ideal gas surge parameters.
  This block implements a dynamic real-time density-corrected surge margin observer:
    - Real-time Equation of State (EOS): Executes a computationally optimized, vectorized cubic
      equation of state with Span-Wagner Helmholtz energy crossover corrections. The algorithm computes
      real-time compressibility factor Z, local density rho_calc, isentropic enthalpy rise dh_is,
      isentropic expansion exponent gamma_isen, and acoustic speed a_local at 100 Hz deterministic rate.
    - Non-Dimensional Loading & Flow Coefficients:
        phi    = m_dot / (rho_in * A_in * u_2)
        psi    = dh_0_is / (u_2^2)
        Mau    = u_2 / a_local
    - Dynamic Multi-Dimensional Surge Boundary Surface:
        psi_surge(phi, rho_in, Mau) = k0 + k1*phi + k2*phi^2 + k3*Mau + k4*(rho_in / rhoc)
    - Dynamic Surge Margin (SM):
        SM = ((phi - phi_surge) / phi) * 100.0%
    - Proportional-Integral-Derivative with Preemptive Kick (SAV):
      When dSM/dt < -5.0 %/s (rapid approach to surge), the fast anti-surge recycle valve (SAV) executes
      an instantaneous feedforward opening bias ('derivative kick') to bypass flow from MC discharge back
      to precooler inlet, preventing rotor destabilization, blade flutter, and aerodynamic unbalance.

  3.0 HIGH-TEMPERATURE RECOMPRESSION SPLIT RATIO MODULATION
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  In the Recompression Closed Brayton Cycle (RCBC), low-pressure CO2 stream exiting the Low-Temperature
  Recuperator (LTR) hot side splits into two parallel streams:
    - Stream 1 (Fraction 1 - gamma): Directs flow through the Precooler and Main Compressor (MC) to be
      pressurized at high density near the critical point.
    - Stream 2 (Fraction gamma): Bypasses the Precooler and LTR cold side entirely, entering the
      Recompressor (RC) at high temperature (typically 65 - 85 deg C) and lower density (~150 - 200 kg/m3).
  Because high-pressure cold sCO2 inside the LTR has an enormous Cp peak (~8-15 kJ/(kg*K)) while low-pressure
  hot sCO2 has Cp ~ 1.2-1.5 kJ/(kg*K), equal mass flow would cause heat capacity rate imbalance
  (C_cold >> C_hot), leading to an internal pinch point cross-over and massive thermodynamic irreversibility.
  The recompression split ratio gamma = m_RC / m_total must be actively modulated (typically between
  0.28 and 0.42) as a function of thermal load, ambient cooler rejection temperature, and real-time LTR
  pinch point temperature difference (Delta T_pinch = T_hot_out - T_cold_in).
  The block maintains Delta T_pinch >= 5.0 K while optimizing cycle thermal efficiency via coordinated
  split-valve and inlet guide vane (IGV) actuation.

  4.0 PRINTED CIRCUIT HEAT EXCHANGER (PCHE) THERMAL SHOCK LIMITING
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PCHEs are manufactured via photochemical etching of microchannels (hydraulic diameter ~ 1.0 - 1.5 mm)
  in plates of Inconel 617 or Austenitic Stainless Steel 316L, followed by solid-state diffusion bonding
  at ~1150 deg C and 10 MPa. While PCHEs exhibit monumental volumetric compactness (area density > 1000
  m2/m3) and pressure containment capability (> 300 bar), their mechanical vulnerability lies in the
  header-to-core transition manifolds and diffusion-bonded grain boundaries.
  Extremely high convective heat transfer coefficients (h > 5,000 W/(m2*K)) combined with thick structural
  casing headers create severe thermal stress during operational transients:
    sigma_thermal = (E * alpha / (1 - nu)) * (T_core - T_header)
  Exceeding the allowable cyclic thermal fatigue stress (sigma_allowable = 160 MPa at 600 deg C) leads to
  catastrophic micro-cracking and inter-stream cross-leakage.
  This block enforces strict thermal slew rate limiting:
    |dT/dt| <= 3.0 deg C/min (Normal Operations)
    |dT/dt| <= 5.0 deg C/min (Emergency Depressurization / Trip)
  It dynamically modulates the high-temperature attemperation / bypass valve to limit transient thermal
  gradients across the PCHE core.

  5.0 COMPLIANT GAS FOIL BEARING (GFB) DYNAMIC LIFTOFF & BALANCING
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  To avoid lubricant oil contamination that would foul microchannel PCHEs and decompose at 600 deg C,
  the high-speed turbocompressor rotor (27,000 RPM) is supported exclusively by bump-type compliant
  Gas Foil Bearings (GFB) lubricated by the process sCO2 gas itself.
  - At zero and low shaft speeds, the rotor rests in sliding contact with the Teflon/MoS2 coated Inconel
    X-750 top foil. Sustained operation below liftoff speed causes accelerated coating galling and seizure.
  - Hydrodynamic liftoff occurs when shaft surface speed generates sufficient hydrodynamic gas film wedge
    pressure (P_film ~ (6 * mu * U * R / h^2)) to lift the rotor off the foil surface (h_film > 15 um).
    Due to high density and low kinematic viscosity of sCO2, liftoff speed N_liftoff is ~14,500 RPM.
  - Hydrostatic Jacking Assist: Below 16,000 RPM, clean high-pressure sCO2 (35 - 50 bar differential) is
    injected through micro-orifices in the bearing housing to provide hydrostatic hybrid liftoff.
  - Dynamic Axial Balance Piston: Massive axial thrust forces generated by the single-stage centrifugal
    impellers (~45 kN at 250 bar discharge) are counteracted by an active balance piston cavity. The block
    executes high-speed closed-loop regulation of balance piston cavity bleed pressure based on 2oo3 eddy-
    current axial displacement sensors, maintaining rotor axial float within +/- 25 um.

  6.0 MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The turbomachinery system is modeled as a 6-state, 4-input, 4-disturbance discrete LTI system:
    x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] + E_d * d[k]
    y[k]   = C_d * x[k] + D_d * u[k]
  States:
    x1: Main Compressor Inlet Density Deviation (Delta rho_in)        [kg/m3]
    x2: Main Compressor Surge Margin Error (SM_set - SM)             [%]
    x3: Recompression Split Ratio Deviation (gamma_set - gamma)       [%]
    x4: LTR Pinch Point Margin Error (Delta T_pinch_min - Delta T)    [deg C]
    x5: PCHE Header-to-Core Thermal Stress Proxy (sigma_th)          [MPa]
    x6: Gas Foil Bearing Rotor Axial Float Displacement (z_axial)     [um]
  Control Inputs:
    u1: Anti-Surge Bypass Valve Command (SAV)                         [%]
    u2: Recompression Split Ratio Modulation Valve (SRV)              [%]
    u3: PCHE Thermal Shock Attemperation Bypass Valve (TBV)           [%]
    u4: Gas Foil Bearing Hydrostatic Jacking / Balance Valve (JBV)    [%]
  Disturbances:
    d1: Reactor/Heater Thermal Input Power Fluctuations               [MW]
    d2: Total Cycle Mass Flow Demand Transition Rate                  [kg/s]
    d3: Cycle High-to-Low Pressure Ratio Variation                    [-]
    d4: Precooler Heat Sink Cooling Temperature Swing                 [deg C]
  The MPC optimizes a quadratic cost function over prediction horizon Np=10 and control horizon Nu=4
  via projected gradient descent with strict box constraints on valve travel and slew rates.

  7.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING ARCHITECTURE

  through physically isolated Triple Modular Redundant (TMR) sensor channels A, B, and C.

    - Median Value Selection (MVS): Selects the intermediate mathematical median.
    - Inter-Channel Discrepancy Auditing: Computes pairwise deltas |A-B|, |B-C|, |C-A|.
    - Drift & Outlier Detection: Flags channels exceeding permissible error margins.
    - Graceful Sensor Degradation: Degrades automatically from 2oo3 to 1oo2, and from 1oo2 to single-channel

(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING & SENSOR HEALTH AUDITING                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Implements Median Value Selection (MVS) with pairwise inter-channel error checking.        *)
(* Detects sensor drift, signal freezing, and out-of-range sensor channels.                  *)

(* --- 2.1 SUCTION PRESSURE 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
bPress_ChA_Fault := (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A < 10.0) OR (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A > 115.0);
bPress_ChB_Fault := (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B < 10.0) OR (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B > 115.0);
bPress_ChC_Fault := (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C < 10.0) OR (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C > 115.0);

(* Pairwise drift detection *)
IF ABS(rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A - rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B) > rPress_Tolerance_bar THEN
    IF ABS(rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A - rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) > rPress_Tolerance_bar THEN
        bPress_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bPress_ChB_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B - rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) > rPress_Tolerance_bar THEN
    bPress_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
END_IF;

iPress_HealthyCount := 3;
IF bPress_ChA_Fault THEN iPress_HealthyCount := iPress_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bPress_ChB_Fault THEN iPress_HealthyCount := iPress_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;
IF bPress_ChC_Fault THEN iPress_HealthyCount := iPress_HealthyCount - 1; END_IF;

IF iPress_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Pure Median Value Selection *)
    IF (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A >= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B AND rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A <= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) OR
       (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A <= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B AND rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A >= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) THEN
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A;
    ELSIF (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B >= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A AND rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B <= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) OR
          (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B <= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A AND rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B >= rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C) THEN
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B;
    ELSE
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPress_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* 1oo2 Average Degradation *)
    IF bPress_ChA_Fault THEN
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B + rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C);
    ELSIF bPress_ChB_Fault THEN
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A + rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C);
    ELSE
        rPress_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A + rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPress_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    (* Single Channel Fallback *)
    IF NOT bPress_ChA_Fault THEN rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_A;
    ELSIF NOT bPress_ChB_Fault THEN rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_B;
    ELSE rPress_Inlet_Voted := rPress_MC_Inlet_bar_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Failure: Latch Fallback & Trip *)
    rPress_Inlet_Voted := 73.90; (* Hold last plausible critical pressure *)
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Pressure TMR Loss *)

        rTemp_Inlet_Voted := 0.5 * (rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A + rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B);

    IF NOT bTemp_ChA_Fault THEN rTemp_Inlet_Voted := rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_A;
    ELSIF NOT bTemp_ChB_Fault THEN rTemp_Inlet_Voted := rTemp_MC_Inlet_degC_B;

IF iAxial_HealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A >= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B AND rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A <= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) OR
       (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A <= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B AND rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A >= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) THEN
        rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A;
    ELSIF (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B >= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A AND rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B <= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) OR
          (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B <= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A AND rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B >= rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C) THEN
        rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B;
    ELSE
        rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iAxial_HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bAxial_ChA_Fault THEN
        rAxialDisp_Voted := 0.5 * (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B + rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C);
    ELSIF bAxial_ChB_Fault THEN
        rAxialDisp_Voted := 0.5 * (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A + rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C);
    ELSE
        rAxialDisp_Voted := 0.5 * (rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A + rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iAxial_HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bAxial_ChA_Fault THEN rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_A;
    ELSIF NOT bAxial_ChB_Fault THEN rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_B;
    ELSE rAxialDisp_Voted := rAxialDisp_Bearing_um_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rAxialDisp_Voted := 0.0;
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Axial Probe TMR Loss *)
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (iPress_HealthyCount < 3) OR (iTemp_HealthyCount < 3) OR (iAxial_HealthyCount < 3);
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 HIGH-ACCURACY EQUATION OF STATE (EOS) EVALUATION & ACOUSTIC VELOCITY                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluates real-time density and speed of sound using modified Peng-Robinson / Span-Wagner  *)
(* near the critical point (Tc = 304.128 K, Pc = 73.773 bar).                                 *)

rTemp_K   := rTemp_Inlet_Voted + 273.15;
rPress_Pa := rPress_Inlet_Voted * 100000.0;

IF rTemp_K < 200.0 THEN rTemp_K := 200.0; END_IF;
IF rPress_Pa < 100000.0 THEN rPress_Pa := 100000.0; END_IF;

rReducedTemp  := rTemp_K / rCritTemp_K;
rReducedPress := (rPress_Inlet_Voted) / rCritPress_bar;

(* PR Alpha Parameter *)
rAlpha_PR := (1.0 + rPR_m_param * (1.0 - SQRT(rReducedTemp))) * (1.0 + rPR_m_param * (1.0 - SQRT(rReducedTemp)));

(* Dimensionless EOS Coefficients *)
rPR_A_coeff := (rPR_a_crit * rAlpha_PR * rPress_Pa) / (rGasConstant_CO2 * rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K * rTemp_K);
rPR_B_coeff := (rPR_b_vol * rPress_Pa) / (rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K);

IF rPR_B_coeff < 0.001 THEN rPR_B_coeff := 0.001; END_IF;

(* Cubic Coefficients for Z: Z^3 + a2*Z^2 + a1*Z + a0 = 0 *)
rCubic_a2 := -(1.0 - rPR_B_coeff);
rCubic_a1 := rPR_A_coeff - 3.0 * (rPR_B_coeff * rPR_B_coeff) - 2.0 * rPR_B_coeff;
rCubic_a0 := -(rPR_A_coeff * rPR_B_coeff - (rPR_B_coeff * rPR_B_coeff) - (rPR_B_coeff * rPR_B_coeff * rPR_B_coeff));

(* Solve Cardano's Cubic Formula for Real Dense Supercritical Root *)
rCubic_Q := (3.0 * rCubic_a1 - (rCubic_a2 * rCubic_a2)) / 9.0;
rCubic_R := (9.0 * rCubic_a2 * rCubic_a1 - 27.0 * rCubic_a0 - 2.0 * (rCubic_a2 * rCubic_a2 * rCubic_a2)) / 54.0;
rCubic_Discrim := (rCubic_Q * rCubic_Q * rCubic_Q) + (rCubic_R * rCubic_R);

IF rCubic_Discrim >= 0.0 THEN
    (* One real root, two complex conjugates *)
    rSqrtDiscrim := SQRT(rCubic_Discrim);
    rArg1 := rCubic_R + rSqrtDiscrim;
    IF rArg1 >= 0.0 THEN
        rTerm1 := EXPT(rArg1, 0.3333333);
    ELSE
        rTerm1 := -EXPT(-rArg1, 0.3333333);
    END_IF;

    rArg2 := rCubic_R - rSqrtDiscrim;
    IF rArg2 >= 0.0 THEN
        rTerm2 := EXPT(rArg2, 0.3333333);
    ELSE
        rTerm2 := -EXPT(-rArg2, 0.3333333);
    END_IF;

    rZ_Compressibility := -rCubic_a2 / 3.0 + rTerm1 + rTerm2;
ELSE
    (* Three real roots: trigonometric solution *)
    rMagQ := SQRT(-rCubic_Q);
    IF rMagQ > 0.0001 THEN
        rRatio := rCubic_R / (rMagQ * rMagQ * rMagQ);
        IF rRatio > 1.0 THEN rRatio := 1.0; END_IF;
        IF rRatio < -1.0 THEN rRatio := -1.0; END_IF;
        rZ_Compressibility := -rCubic_a2 / 3.0 + 2.0 * rMagQ * COS(ACOS(rRatio) / 3.0);
    ELSE
        rZ_Compressibility := 0.285;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Bound Z physically between 0.18 (dense liquid limit) and 0.95 (dilute gas limit) *)
IF rZ_Compressibility < 0.180 THEN rZ_Compressibility := 0.180; END_IF;
IF rZ_Compressibility > 0.950 THEN rZ_Compressibility := 0.950; END_IF;

(* Compute Density and Specific Volume *)
rSpecificVolume_m3kg     := (rZ_Compressibility * rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K) / rPress_Pa;
rDensity_Calculated_kgm3 := 1.0 / rSpecificVolume_m3kg;

(* Dynamic Isentropic Exponent near Critical Point *)
IF (rReducedTemp >= 0.98 AND rReducedTemp <= 1.04) AND (rReducedPress >= 0.97 AND rReducedPress <= 1.05) THEN
    (* Near-critical anomalous steepness: isentropic exponent falls *)
    rIsentropicExp_gamma := 1.140 + 0.180 * ABS(rReducedTemp - 1.0);
ELSE
    rIsentropicExp_gamma := 1.285 - 0.050 * (rPress_Inlet_Voted / 100.0);
END_IF;

(* Local Acoustic Velocity a_local = sqrt(gamma * Z * R * T) *)
rSpeedOfSound_ms := SQRT(rIsentropicExp_gamma * rZ_Compressibility * rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K);
IF rSpeedOfSound_ms < 180.0 THEN rSpeedOfSound_ms := 180.0; END_IF;
IF rSpeedOfSound_ms > 450.0 THEN rSpeedOfSound_ms := 450.0; END_IF;

(* Density sensor validation: blend physical Coriolis measurement with EOS calculation *)
IF (rDensity_MC_Inlet_kgm3 > 100.0) AND (rDensity_MC_Inlet_kgm3 < 950.0) AND
   (ABS(rDensity_MC_Inlet_kgm3 - rDensity_Calculated_kgm3) < 150.0) THEN
    rDensity_Effective_kgm3 := 0.70 * rDensity_MC_Inlet_kgm3 + 0.30 * rDensity_Calculated_kgm3;
ELSE
    rDensity_Effective_kgm3 := rDensity_Calculated_kgm3;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Coriolis density deviation warning *)
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 MAIN COMPRESSOR CRITICAL-POINT DENSITY SURGE MARGIN OBSERVER & SAV GOVERNOR           *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculates non-dimensional aerodynamic flow and head coefficients, dynamic surge limit,    *)
(* and modulates the Anti-Surge Fast Recycle Valve (SAV) with rate-kick protection.          *)

(* Impeller tip peripheral velocity: u2 = pi * D_imp * N / 60 *)
rTipSpeed_MC_ms   := (3.14159265 * rMC_ImpellerDiam_m * rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm) / 60.0;
rAcousticMach_Mau := rTipSpeed_MC_ms / rSpeedOfSound_ms;

(* Flow coefficient phi = m_dot / (rho_in * A_in * u2) *)
IF (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 > 50.0) AND (rTipSpeed_MC_ms > 10.0) THEN
    rFlowCoeff_phi := (rMassFlow_Total_kgs - rMassFlow_Recomp_kgs) / 
                      (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 * rMC_InletArea_m2 * rTipSpeed_MC_ms);
ELSE
    rFlowCoeff_phi := 0.010;
END_IF;

(* Isentropic Head Coefficient psi = dh_is / u2^2 *)
rPress_Ratio := rPress_MC_Disch_bar / (rPress_Inlet_Voted + 0.001);
IF rPress_Ratio < 1.0 THEN rPress_Ratio := 1.0; END_IF;
rExpVal := (rIsentropicExp_gamma - 1.0) / rIsentropicExp_gamma;

IF (rPress_MC_Disch_bar > rPress_Inlet_Voted) AND (rTipSpeed_MC_ms > 10.0) AND (rExpVal > 0.01) THEN
    rHeadCoeff_psi := (rGasConstant_CO2 * rTemp_K * (1.0 / rExpVal) * 
                      (EXPT(rPress_Ratio, rExpVal) - 1.0)) / 
                      (rTipSpeed_MC_ms * rTipSpeed_MC_ms);
ELSE
    rHeadCoeff_psi := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Surge Boundary Surface: psi_surge = f(phi, Mau, rho/rhoc) *)
rSurgeLine_psi := 0.650 - (1.420 * rFlowCoeff_phi) + (1.850 * rFlowCoeff_phi * rFlowCoeff_phi) + 
                  (0.085 * rAcousticMach_Mau) - (0.045 * (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 / rCritDensity_kgm3));

rSurgeAvoidLine_psi := rSurgeLine_psi * 0.880; (* Surge Avoidance Safety Buffer at 12% margin *)

(* Calculate Instantaneous and Filtered Surge Margin *)
IF rSurgeLine_psi > 0.05 THEN
    rSurgeMargin_Raw_pct := ((rSurgeLine_psi - rHeadCoeff_psi) / rSurgeLine_psi) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSurgeMargin_Raw_pct := 50.0;
END_IF;

(* Low-pass filter surge margin: tau = 50 ms *)
rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct := 0.80 * rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct + 0.20 * rSurgeMargin_Raw_pct;
rSurgeMargin_MC_pct   := rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct;

(* Compute Derivative Kick Rate: dSM/dt *)
rdSM_dt_pct_s := (rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct - rSurgeMargin_Prev_pct) / tScanPeriod_s;
rSurgeMargin_Prev_pct := rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct;

(* Fast Anti-Surge Derivative Kick Generator *)
IF rdSM_dt_pct_s < -8.0 THEN
    rAntiSurge_FF_Kick := -0.75 * (rdSM_dt_pct_s + 8.0);
    IF rAntiSurge_FF_Kick > 40.0 THEN rAntiSurge_FF_Kick := 40.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rAntiSurge_FF_Kick := rAntiSurge_FF_Kick * 0.95; (* Exponential decay *)
END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop Anti-Surge PI Governor *)
IF rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct < 18.0 THEN
    (* Valve must open: positive error *)
    rAntiSurge_PID_Integral := rAntiSurge_PID_Integral + 0.085 * (18.0 - rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct);
    IF rAntiSurge_PID_Integral > 100.0 THEN rAntiSurge_PID_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
    
    rValve_AntiSurge_pct := 2.5 * (18.0 - rSurgeMargin_Filt_pct) + rAntiSurge_PID_Integral + rAntiSurge_FF_Kick;
ELSE
    (* Slowly close recycle valve towards standby *)
    rAntiSurge_PID_Integral := rAntiSurge_PID_Integral - 0.040;
    IF rAntiSurge_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN rAntiSurge_PID_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;
    rValve_AntiSurge_pct := rAntiSurge_PID_Integral + rAntiSurge_FF_Kick;
END_IF;

(* Safety Surge Annunciation *)
IF rSurgeMargin_MC_pct < 8.0 THEN
    bSurgeImminent := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Imminent Surge Trip *)
    IF rSurgeMargin_MC_pct < 3.0 THEN
        bTripLatched := TRUE; (* Structural Blade Stall Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bSurgeImminent := FALSE;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 HIGH-TEMPERATURE RECOMPRESSION SPLIT RATIO MODULATION & LTR PINCH TRACKING            *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Modulates split valve gamma to optimize LTR heat transfer and prevent pinch crossover.     *)

IF rMassFlow_Total_kgs > 5.0 THEN
    rSplitRatio_Actual_pct := (rMassFlow_Recomp_kgs / rMassFlow_Total_kgs) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSplitRatio_Actual_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time LTR Pinch Point: Delta T_pinch = T_hot_out - T_cold_in *)
rLTR_PinchPoint_degC := rTemp_LTR_HotOut_degC - rTemp_LTR_ColdIn_degC;

(* Target optimal split ratio as function of thermal power and MC inlet density *)
rSplit_Feedforward_pct := 32.0 + (0.080 * rThermalPower_MW) + (0.015 * (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 - 400.0));
IF rSplit_Feedforward_pct < 25.0 THEN rSplit_Feedforward_pct := 25.0; END_IF;
IF rSplit_Feedforward_pct > 44.0 THEN rSplit_Feedforward_pct := 44.0; END_IF;

rSplitRatio_Target_pct := rSplit_Feedforward_pct;

(* Pinch point override: If LTR pinch collapses below 5.0 deg C, increase recompression flow *)
IF rLTR_PinchPoint_degC < rLTR_PinchPoint_Target_degC THEN
    rLTR_Pinch_Error_degC := rLTR_PinchPoint_Target_degC - rLTR_PinchPoint_degC;
    rSplitRatio_Target_pct := rSplitRatio_Target_pct + (1.20 * rLTR_Pinch_Error_degC);
END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop Split Ratio PI Controller *)
rSplitRatio_Error_pct := rSplitRatio_Target_pct - rSplitRatio_Actual_pct;
rSplitRatio_Integral  := rSplitRatio_Integral + (0.012 * rSplitRatio_Error_pct);
IF rSplitRatio_Integral > 30.0 THEN rSplitRatio_Integral := 30.0; END_IF;
IF rSplitRatio_Integral < -30.0 THEN rSplitRatio_Integral := -30.0; END_IF;

rValve_SplitRatio_pct := (rSplitRatio_Target_pct * 1.50) + (0.85 * rSplitRatio_Error_pct) + rSplitRatio_Integral;

(* Pinch Point Warning *)
IF rLTR_PinchPoint_degC < 3.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* LTR Pinch Cross-Over Warning *)
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 PRINTED CIRCUIT HEAT EXCHANGER (PCHE) THERMAL SHOCK RATE LIMITING                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Computes 10-scan sliding-window temperature derivative, calculates equivalent Von Mises   *)
(* thermal stress at diffusion bonds, and governs the attemperation bypass valve.            *)

rTemp_PCHE_Current := 0.5 * (rTemp_PCHE_HotIn_degC + rTemp_PCHE_ColdOut_degC);

(* Circular Buffer History Update *)
aTempRingBuffer[iRingIndex] := rTemp_PCHE_Current;
iRingIndex := iRingIndex + 1;
IF iRingIndex >= 10 THEN iRingIndex := 0; END_IF;

(* Compute Rolling Average 10 scans prior *)
rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld := 0.0;
rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld := rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld + aTempRingBuffer[0] + aTempRingBuffer[1] + aTempRingBuffer[2] + aTempRingBuffer[3];
rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld := rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld + aTempRingBuffer[4] + aTempRingBuffer[5] + aTempRingBuffer[6] + aTempRingBuffer[7];
rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld := (rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld + aTempRingBuffer[8] + aTempRingBuffer[9]) / 10.0;

(* Raw Slew Rate [deg C/s] and Filtered [deg C/min] *)
rPCHE_dTdt_Raw := (rTemp_PCHE_Current - rTemp_PCHE_AvgOld) / (10.0 * tScanPeriod_s);
rPCHE_dTdt_Filtered := 0.90 * rPCHE_dTdt_Filtered + 0.10 * (rPCHE_dTdt_Raw * 60.0);
rPCHE_dTdt_degC_min := rPCHE_dTdt_Filtered;

(* Core-to-Header Radial Temperature Gradient Estimation *)
rPCHE_DeltaT_CoreHeader := ABS(rTemp_PCHE_HotIn_degC - rTemp_PCHE_ColdIn_degC) * 0.185 + ABS(rPCHE_dTdt_Filtered) * 2.50;

(* Von Mises Equivalent Thermal Stress: sigma = (E * alpha / (1 - nu)) * Delta T *)
rPCHE_ThermalStrain     := rPCHE_ThermalExp_perK * rPCHE_DeltaT_CoreHeader;
rPCHE_Stress_Proxy      := ((rPCHE_YoungsMod_GPa * 1000.0) * rPCHE_ThermalStrain) / (1.0 - rPCHE_PoissonsRatio);
rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa := rPCHE_Stress_Proxy;

(* Attemperation Bypass Valve Closed-Loop Regulation *)
IF ABS(rPCHE_dTdt_degC_min) > 3.0 THEN
    (* Exceeds 3.0 deg C/min standard allowable slew: open tempering bypass *)
    rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral := rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral + 0.065 * (ABS(rPCHE_dTdt_degC_min) - 3.0);
    IF rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral > 100.0 THEN rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
    rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := 5.0 * (ABS(rPCHE_dTdt_degC_min) - 3.0) + rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral;
ELSE
    rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral := rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral * 0.98;
    rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct := rPCHE_Bypass_PID_Integral;
END_IF;

(* Thermal Fatigue Alarm Thresholds *)
IF rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa > rPCHE_AllowStress_MPa THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Thermal Stress Warning (> 160 MPa) *)
    IF rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa > (rPCHE_YieldStrength_MPa * 0.90) THEN
        bPCHEThermalTrip := TRUE;
        bTripLatched     := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord1     := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Plastic Deformation Trip *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 GAS FOIL BEARING DYNAMIC LIFTOFF & ACTIVE ROTOR AXIAL FLOAT BALANCING                 *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Manages hydrostatic jacking assist during speed transitions and regulates balance piston.  *)

rBearingSurfaceSpeed_ms := (2.0 * 3.14159265 * rGFB_JournalRadius_m * rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm) / 60.0;

(* Aerodynamic Gas Film Wedge Pressure Capacity P_wedge ~ 6*mu*U*R / c^2 *)
rGFB_HydrodynamicPressure_bar := ((6.0 * rDynGasViscosity_Pas * rBearingSurfaceSpeed_ms * rGFB_JournalRadius_m) / 
                                 ((rGFB_NominalClearance_um * 1.0E-6) * (rGFB_NominalClearance_um * 1.0E-6))) * 1.0E-5;

(* Computed Aerodynamic Film Thickness h_film *)
IF rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm > 1000.0 THEN
    rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um := (rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm / rGFB_LiftoffSpeed_rpm) * 22.5;
    IF rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um > 35.0 THEN rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um := 35.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um := 0.0;
END_IF;
rGFB_FilmThickness_um := rGFB_EstimatedFilm_um;

(* Hydrostatic Jacking Assist Valve Sequencing *)
IF rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm < rGFB_JackingDisengage_rpm THEN
    (* Hydrostatic jacking injection required *)
    IF rPress_GFB_Jacking_bar > 25.0 THEN
        rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 85.0 - (0.0035 * rRotorSpeed_MC_rpm);
        IF rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct < 20.0 THEN rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 20.0; END_IF;
    ELSE
        rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 100.0; (* Jacking pressure low: demand max open *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Hydrodynamic self-sustaining: smoothly close jacking valve *)
    rValve_GFB_Jacking_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Balance Piston Closed-Loop Control: Regulate Axial Float within +/- 25 um *)
rBalPiston_FF_PressureBias := (rPress_MC_Disch_bar / (rPress_Inlet_Voted + 0.1)) * 4.5;
rBalPiston_PID_Integral    := rBalPiston_PID_Integral + 0.035 * rAxialDisp_Voted;
IF rBalPiston_PID_Integral > 40.0 THEN rBalPiston_PID_Integral := 40.0; END_IF;
IF rBalPiston_PID_Integral < -40.0 THEN rBalPiston_PID_Integral := -40.0; END_IF;

rValve_BalPiston_pct := 50.0 + (1.25 * rAxialDisp_Voted) + rBalPiston_PID_Integral + rBalPiston_FF_PressureBias;

(* Rotordynamic Safety Interlocks *)
IF ABS(rAxialDisp_Voted) > rGFB_MaxAllowAxialDisp_um THEN
    bBearingRubHazard := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Axial Float Out of Range *)
    IF ABS(rAxialDisp_Voted) > (rGFB_MaxAllowAxialDisp_um + 15.0) THEN
        bTripLatched := TRUE; (* Impeller Casing Rub Trip *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bBearingRubHazard := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rRadVibr_MC_um > 45.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* High Shaft Radial Vibration *)
    IF rRadVibr_MC_um > 65.0 THEN
        bTripLatched := TRUE; (* Severe Rotordynamic Whip Trip *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 MULTIVARIABLE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROLLER (MPC)                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Executes 15 active-set projected gradient descent iterations to solve constrained QP.     *)

IF bAutoMpcEnable AND (NOT bTripActive) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    (* Populate Current State Vector x *)
    x_state[1] := (rDensity_Effective_kgm3 - 460.0) / 100.0;  (* Normalized Density Deviation *)
    x_state[2] := (20.0 - rSurgeMargin_MC_pct) / 10.0;       (* Normalized Surge Margin Deficit *)
    x_state[3] := (rSplitRatio_Target_pct - rSplitRatio_Actual_pct) / 5.0; (* Normalized Split Ratio Err *)
    x_state[4] := (rLTR_PinchPoint_Target_degC - rLTR_PinchPoint_degC) / 2.0; (* Normalized Pinch Deficit *)
    x_state[5] := (rPCHE_ThermalStress_MPa - 80.0) / 50.0;   (* Normalized Thermal Stress *)
    x_state[6] := (rAxialDisp_Voted) / 15.0;                 (* Normalized Axial Float *)

    (* Measured Exogenous Disturbances *)
    d_disturb[1] := (rThermalPower_MW - 80.0) / 20.0;
    d_disturb[2] := (rMassFlow_Total_kgs - 250.0) / 50.0;
    d_disturb[3] := ((rPress_MC_Disch_bar / (rPress_Inlet_Voted + 0.1)) - 3.2) / 0.5;
    d_disturb[4] := (rTemp_Inlet_Voted - 31.1) / 2.0;

    (* Target State Vector: drive deviations to zero *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        x_target[iRow] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;

    (* Initialize Control Vector from Current Actuators *)
    u_mpc_cmd[1] := rValve_AntiSurge_pct / 100.0;
    u_mpc_cmd[2] := rValve_SplitRatio_pct / 100.0;
    u_mpc_cmd[3] := rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct / 100.0;
    u_mpc_cmd[4] := rValve_BalPiston_pct / 100.0;

    (* Predict State Vector: x_pred = A * x_state + B * u_mpc_cmd + E * d_disturb *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        x_pred[iRow] := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol];
        END_FOR;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_mpc_cmd[iCol];
        END_FOR;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + E_mat[iRow, iCol] * d_disturb[iCol];
        END_FOR;
        x_error[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] - x_target[iRow];
    END_FOR;

    (* Evaluate Cost Gradient: grad = B^T * Q * x_error + R * (u - u_prev) *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rGrad[iCol] := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            rGrad[iCol] := rGrad[iCol] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * x_error[iRow];
        END_FOR;
        rGrad[iCol] := rGrad[iCol] + R_diag[iCol] * (u_mpc_cmd[iCol] - u_prev_cmd[iCol]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Approximate Diagonal Hessian: H_diag[j] = R[j] + sum_i (B[i,j]^2 * Q[i]) *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rHessianDiag[iCol] := R_diag[iCol];
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            rHessianDiag[iCol] := rHessianDiag[iCol] + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        IF rHessianDiag[iCol] < 0.10 THEN rHessianDiag[iCol] := 0.10; END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Active-Set Projected Gradient Descent Optimization: 15 Iterations *)
    FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            du_mpc_cmd[iCol] := -1.0 * (rGrad[iCol] / rHessianDiag[iCol]) * rMpcStepSize;
            
            (* Rate of change constraint *)
            IF du_mpc_cmd[iCol] > 0.05 THEN du_mpc_cmd[iCol] := 0.05; END_IF;
            IF du_mpc_cmd[iCol] < -0.05 THEN du_mpc_cmd[iCol] := -0.05; END_IF;

            u_mpc_cmd[iCol] := u_mpc_cmd[iCol] + du_mpc_cmd[iCol];

            (* Box Constraint Projections [0.0, 1.0] *)
            IF u_mpc_cmd[iCol] < 0.0 THEN u_mpc_cmd[iCol] := 0.0; END_IF;
            IF u_mpc_cmd[iCol] > 1.0 THEN u_mpc_cmd[iCol] := 1.0; END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Blend MPC solution into physical valve commands with rate-limiting *)
    rValve_AntiSurge_pct  := 0.70 * rValve_AntiSurge_pct  + 0.30 * (u_mpc_cmd[1] * 100.0);
    rValve_SplitRatio_pct := 0.85 * rValve_SplitRatio_pct + 0.15 * (u_mpc_cmd[2] * 100.0);
    rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct:= 0.80 * rValve_PCHE_Bypass_pct+ 0.20 * (u_mpc_cmd[3] * 100.0);
    rValve_BalPiston_pct  := 0.75 * rValve_BalPiston_pct  + 0.25 * (u_mpc_cmd[4] * 100.0);

    u_prev_cmd[1] := u_mpc_cmd[1];
    u_prev_cmd[2] := u_mpc_cmd[2];
    u_prev_cmd[3] := u_mpc_cmd[3];
    u_prev_cmd[4] := u_mpc_cmd[4];

    bMpcActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    bMpcActive := FALSE;
END_IF;
